caption: The drawing depicts a painted statue of a standing woman, positioned on a black rectangular base. She is dressed in a tan fringed dress with light blue trim at the hem and sleeves, and a red sash tied at the waist with fringed ends. The figure wears brown shoes and a necklace of black beads. On her head, she has a tan headband with blue and white feathers attached. Her left hand rests at her side while her right hand extends forward, holding a small cylindrical object. Behind her, a textured vertical brown post runs from the base to her shoulder height, supporting her position. The background is a plain off-white color with various yellow-brown stains and marks scattered throughout.
title: Cigar Store Indian
